objective: Falsify whether the qualified breadth association is incremental to fixed observed trend controls.

method.partial_rank: Pearson correlation of feature/outcome residuals after pooled percentile ranks for continuous variables, fixed control ranks, and entry-year dummies; binary outcomes remain 0/1 before residualization
method.loyo: repeat unchanged model omitting each entry year 2018..2025
method.trend_strata: fixed quintiles of the mean within-year percentile rank of the three controls; compare top versus bottom breadth terciles inside each stratum
method.missing: complete cases per breadth-outcome-control set; no imputation

support_gate: At least two breadth features have partial rho >=0.10 for MFE or winner_ge20, positive sign in >=7/8 LOYO estimates, positive top-minus-bottom effect in >=4/5 trend strata, and no winner_ge50 partial rho <=-0.10.
